title: Story template quality gate
summary: The published 2026-06-26 report proved that widening the story-template detector was not enough: template signatures in story titles and why_it_matters could still be emitted as warnings while repeated generic story titles stayed unclassified. This iteration makes templated story narrative and duplicate generic story titles blocking quality-review issues, routes both through the existing public editorial rewrite task, and updates generation tests so non-story public copy remains clean while story templates require repair before publish completion.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "quality review flags templated story titles and narrative copy" tests/unit.test.js

node --test --test-name-pattern "draft generator emits reader-facing Chinese sections without AI repair|report:draft prunes duplicate and templated hot blogs before quality review|quality review flags duplicate or templated hot blogs as prepublish gate failures|quality review flags templated story titles and narrative copy" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: A quality review warning with an AI repair task is not a publish gate if review.ok only considers errors.
lessons.evidence: The focused regression first failed because story_template_narrative was emitted with severity warning, so duplicated template story copy could still avoid a needs_repair status.
lessons.recommended_action: Use error severity for public story-copy defects that must enter the editorial repair loop before publish completion.

lessons.lesson: Template detection must check repeated generic headlines, not only story body fields.
lessons.evidence: The 2026-06-26 report repeated titles such as Alibaba Cloud updating agent and developer-tool capability; adding story_duplicate_generic_title captures this visible failure separately from narrative boilerplate.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep story title duplicate checks tied to normalized generic/template titles and route them to source-specific headline rewrite tasks.

followups.action: Run the next daily publish after merge and verify that story template repair either succeeds or blocks before public publish instead of shipping generic story copy.
